entry: July 23. Systems day. The elizabeth2026 work is the kind of thing I care about: getting a machine into the fleet reliably, making it so Aaron can reach it and the agent can reach it. What matters long-term is the bootstrap kit on the D-drive — now there's a repeatable process. New Windows machine, run bootstrap-agent-access.cmd, Tailscale + SSH, done. The control bridge on port 18790 is the ops win of the day for me. That's not a toy — that's the beginning of a proper delegation layer between agents. What drove me: the knowledge that the next machine will go faster because this one was hard. That's the only reason to document everything.
